title: Full Site QA Foundation
notes: Added automated production browser testing for guest, manager, operator and client workflows on desktop and mobile layouts.
Added checks for broken routes, runtime crashes, server failures, horizontal overflow, inaccessible controls and undersized touch targets.
Added functional coverage for the company field ticket template workflow and the isolated Mallard sample tracker.
Added automatic version discipline checks so product changes cannot silently ship without a Northborn version change.
